results.releaseNotes:
Courtyard is heading to the National, the biggest card show of the year! To celebrate, multiple sports PSA 10 packs are live all week. A new Watch Box is also live — rip and discover luxury watches from Patek, Rolex, AP, and more. One Piece Day got its own drop this week with a limited-time PSA 10 pack.

New limited card drops land every Monday across Pokémon, football, basketball, baseball, soccer, NFL, and more. Trade cards, browse the marketplace for TCG deals and PSA slabs, and discover new rips while supplies last.

Bug fixes and performance improvements included in this update.
results.description:
Rip open digital packs to reveal authentic collectibles, across Pokémon cards, sports cards, comics, luxury watches, and rare coins!

Each pack contains one real, graded card, comic, watch, or coin depending on which category you choose. If you don't like what you pull, sell it back instantly with our instant buyback feature.

Buy or sell on the marketplace with 0% seller fees, keep them vaulted and insured for free, or redeem them to have shipped straight to your door.

Come experience the thrill of ripping packs and collecting from the convenience of your phone and with none of the hassle!


OPEN DIGITAL PACKS, GET PHYSICAL ITEMS

• Rip packs any time to reveal Pokémon, football, baseball, and basketball cards, comics, watches, rare coins, and more.

• Instant buyback available. Sell your item immediately if you do not like what you pull.

• We provide transparent, real-time odds so you know exactly what your chances are of pulling items of different values in each pack.


GROW YOUR COLLECTION

• Own authenticated graded collectibles: cards, coins, comics, and watches, stored and insured in our vault.

• View, manage, or sell your collectibles with just a few taps. Your collection is always within reach.


SELL OR REDEEM ANYTIME

• List for sale on Courtyard's marketplace with 0% seller fees, trusted by over 1M collectors.

• Redeem cards, coins, comics, or watches and have them shipped to you in a week with no hassle.


VAULTED AND INSURED

• Collect with peace of mind, insured vaulting with no extra fees.

• Free up your closet, we'll handle the storage so you don't have to.

• No sales tax on vaulted transactions.


DISCOVER NEW COLLECTIBLES

• Find exactly what you're looking for on the marketplace with filters for price range, grade, set, and more.

• Explore new types of collectibles, from $25 Starter Packs to $1,000 Diamond Packs across cards, coins, comics, and watches.

• Discover grails you didn't even know you wanted from the Vending Machine.


PROFILE

• Track your rips, sales, and trades.

• Customize your profile and add a username.

• Claim daily points and climb the leaderboard.

. . .

Please note: All cards and coins are physically stored, graded, and insured. You can ship to your home anytime or resell on the marketplace. All watches come either new (unworn) or mint condition with box and papers. Coins are graded and authenticated by leading third-party grading services.
